content_sections.text: Candidates who are interested in applying for the IIT Roorkee Recruitment 2026 should first download and carefully read the official notification PDF. The notification contains complete details about vacancy distribution, eligibility criteria, age limit, stipend/salary, selection process, important dates, and application instructions. Reading the official document is important to ensure that you meet all requirements before submitting the application form. IIT Roorkee General Duty Medical Officer Selection Process 2026
Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for IIT Roorkee General Duty Medical Officer Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the post name for the IIT Roorkee recruitment?
faq.answer: The post name for this recruitment is General Duty Medical Officer on a contract basis.

faq.question: Q2. What is the total number of vacancies announced?
faq.answer: A total of 1 vacancy has been announced for the General Duty Medical Officer position.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for this post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess an MBBS degree (including 01-year Internship) and have registration with a Medical Council (State/NMC).

faq.question: Q4. Is there any experience required for the General Duty Medical Officer role?
faq.answer: Yes, candidates need to have at least 01 year of experience in any Government or Private hospital.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for this position?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a consolidated amount of Rs. 80,000/- per month.

faq.question: Q6. What is the mode of application for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The mode of application is Walk-in Interview.

faq.question: Q7. When is the walk-in interview scheduled?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is scheduled for 09 October 2026.

faq.question: Q8. What documents should candidates bring to the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates must bring their detailed CV, experience certificates, proof of Date of Birth, 10th & 12th certificates, MBBS marksheets & degree, Medical Registration certificate, and experience certificates.

faq.question: Q9. Where is the walk-in interview venue?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be held at IIT Roorkee Institute Hospital.

faq.question: Q10. Is there an application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No application fee is mentioned in the official notification for this recruitment drive.
